title: Touch-sensing digital pixel fibre enables interactive garment GUI
title_zh: 触觉感知数字像素纤维实现交互式服装图形用户界面
abstract: Wearable computing promises to transform human interaction with information, yet conventional graphical user interfaces (GUIs) rely on planar, rigid displays incompatible with textiles, which are composed of one-dimensional fibres. Despite recent progress1,2 in flexible and fibre-based displays, bridging this fundamental dimensional mismatch remains challenging because existing approaches do not naturally provide the digitally addressable, high-throughput, information-rich interfaces required for interactive GUIs. Here we present a digital pixel fibre integrating addressable pixels, a common propagation-axis interconnection for scalable in-fibre circuitry and a coaxial sensing layer for fibre-level touch localization. Microelectronic components and a touch-gated resistive path system form a linear circuit that acts as both an interactive display backbone and a computational bus, while peripheral multimodal fibre sensors and actuators enable physiological, inertial, optical, and acoustic input and output. We integrate these fibres into the forearm portion of a garment sleeve to realize a GUI with a 96 × 54-pixel display, 30-frame-per-second refresh rate and 8-bit colour depth. It supports dynamic graphics, integrated audio–video playback, wireless data exchange and interactive computing functions, while maintaining the flexibility, washability, breathability and mechanical robustness of everyday textiles. By merging display, sensing and computation within a single fibre, this work establishes a scalable platform for intrinsically interactive textiles, opening pathways toward garments that operate as fully integrated computational systems. Multifunctional digital fibres integrate display, touch sensing, computation and multimodal input–output, enabling flexible, washable garments with interactive graphical interfaces and wireless multimedia capabilities.
abstract_zh: 可穿戴计算有望改变人类与信息的交互方式，但传统图形用户界面（GUI）依赖平面、刚性显示器，与由一维纤维组成的纺织品不兼容。尽管在柔性和纤维式显示器方面取得了最近的进展1,2，但弥合这种基本维度不匹配仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法不能自然提供交互式 GUI 所需的可寻址像素、高吞吐量、信息丰富的界面。这里我们提出一种数字像素纤维，它集成了可寻址像素、用于可扩展纤维内电路的共同传播轴互连以及用于纤维级触摸定位的同轴感测层。微电子元件和触控门控电阻路径系统构成线性电路，既作为交互式显示骨干，也作为计算总线，而外围多模态纤维传感器和执行器则能够生理、惯性、光学和声学输入输出。我们将这些纤维集成到衣袖的前臂部分，以实现具有 96 × 54 像素显示屏、30 帧/秒刷新率和 8 位色深的 GUI。它支持动态图形、集成音视频播放、无线数据交换和交互式计算功能，同时保持日常纺织品的柔韧性、可水洗性、透气性和机械强度。通过将显示、感测和计算合并在单个纤维中，这项工作为固有交互式纺织品建立了可扩展平台，为完全集成计算系统的服装打开了道路。多功能数字纤维集成显示、触摸感测、计算和多模态输入输出，实现具有交互式图形界面和无线多媒体功能的柔韧、可水洗服装。
